airport.name: Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj International Airport
airport.disclaimer: Terminal footprints, gates, facilities and levels are derived from OpenStreetMap and are not field-verified. Hall, entrance, security and gate connectors are inferred schematic links, not surveyed corridors. Follow airport signs and staff instructions.
airport.liveFlightSource: Live provider lookup when configured; manual entry and demo flights always work. The BLR airport board is used only for BLR.

notes: A complimentary inter-terminal coach connects T1 and T2.
T1 pick-up: arrival exit, towards Departure Gate 2. T2 pick-up: Level 1, Ground Transportation Level (P4).
The service is published as 24x7 with departures every 25 minutes. Confirm eligibility and baggage steps with airline or airport staff.
shuttle.source: CSMIA Inter Terminal Coach Facility (csmia-mumbai.adaniairports.com), retrieved 2026-11-02
shuttle.geometrySource: Straight-line schematic connector between mapped terminal halls
